userMessage: Fingerprint review page for Change Radar (ADR 0005 decision 3): lists every signal fingerprint, grouped by signal and then by group (facets in a group must all match; any group can match), filtered by status (To review, Accepted, Rejected) and by how it was extracted. Each row shows facet, value, role, confidence (with a below-threshold badge against config fingerprint_confidence_threshold), the reason, and last changed by and on. Accept, Reject and Back to review write the fingerprint's Status only. Before each decision the row says what it does to its group at the next daily match run (06:00 UTC): opens, closes (with the open exposures, live and demo, that will close), widens, narrows, adds or removes a tenant setting check, or no change; it also warns when a value is outside the vocabulary or the signal would be left with no accepted fingerprint. Closes and widens ask for confirmation. British English.
agentMessage: Created the Fingerprint review page. It reads fingerprints, signals, active rules, open exposures, the confidence threshold and the vocabulary, and writes only the fingerprint's Status. The effect preview mirrors the matching engine and passes 19 expected cases and 18 engine scenarios.
